decisions.targets: the oracle's verified claim sets (option A), 14 September 2026

target: oracle witness in the grammar's field order: claim_id, claim_type, cites, subject, then the type's own fields
checks: passes the frozen verifier and renders

held_out.rule: 7 subjects; seed 0, then 1, 2, ... until all three tiers are covered

token_lengths.measured_with: llama-tokenize b10927, no BOS, chat template excluded

template_parity: The trainer must render each student's chat template exactly as llama.cpp --jinja does at evaluation, with the prompt as the only user message and no system message. Check by rendering one prompt both ways before training. Qwen2.5 inserts its default system message when none is given. Llama 3.2 writes a date into its system header, so pin the same date_string for training and evaluation.
